title: Normalized open-extension coefficient coherence
statement: Let C have object universe c and morphism universe v, let k=max(c,v,r), suppose C is essentially small in k, let J be a Grothendieck topology on C, and U an object. There exists normalized coefficient comparison data [def-pur-sequence-site-open-data] for all morphisms R→S of k-universe commutative ring sheaves. This includes the actual summand equation, sectionwise identity restriction and composition comparisons, and all unit, counit, composition and identity equations in that definition.

proof.text: Use the normalized identity-induced sheaf comparison and restriction isomorphism of [lem-cbc-ringed-open-scalar-adjunction]. Take the inverse orientation for the coefficient datum.

Define both scalar-composition comparisons by the sectionwise identity. The unit equation is the summand formula; cancel the comparison isomorphism in the existing counit equation. To prove composition, apply the fixed open-adjunction Hom equivalence and evaluate its unit on sections. Naturality of the unit moves the scalar-composition map across extension; the summand formula twice identifies the two sides. The identity follows by the same injective Hom-equivalence test.
